QUOTE: The scope's reason string says which case applied: "no `.clew.yaml` was found at …" or "exists but carries no `index_scope`." A declaration that is present but unusable also falls through, with the rejection reason carried into the reason string.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the whole-repo fallback carries a reason string explaining which case applied and why, so an unstated scope is not silently guessed.
